text:
maya: Quick sync — post-launch backlog triage. We need to decide which customer-reported regressions to hotpatch vs fold into the next minor. Proposed criteria: severity, # of affected customers, customer tier (Dedicated/Enterprise), effort estimate (<1d vs >3d), and rollout risk. Thoughts?

liam: Agree on criteria. Can we score items 1-5? I'm most worried about the prefix-streaming regression (customer A) — high impact. Fix might touch runtime codepaths.

sophia: Runtime touch usually means >1 sprint. Can we mitigate with routing fallback to a previous model variant for impacted tenants? That would be much faster.

maya: Good idea. @liam can you validate if a fallback route is feasible today and how long to roll it out (canary + verify)?

liam: Quick check: fallback path exists in routing layer but requires a small config change + canary rollout + smoke tests. Estimate 6-8 hours end-to-end. Low risk.

oliver: UX note: customer B reported tokenization display oddness in console — annoying but not blocking. I'd push that to next minor and bundle with other polish.

sam: FYI customer A (enterprise) is pushing for a fast fix. They'll accept a config fallback temporarily, but they want a timeline for a proper hotpatch if fallback is insufficient.

release-bot: Deploy scheduled: 2025-03-15 22:00 UTC (canary window) — automated canary health checks enabled.

maya: Plan so far: 1) Roll fallback route in canary tonight (release-bot window). 2) Monitor latency/error deltas for 24h. 3) If errors persist or regression resurfaces for enterprise tenants, escalate to hotpatch (owner: eng runtime). 4) Move low-impact UX polish to next minor. I'll update the roadmap and owner matrix. :white_check_mark:

liam: I'll open two tickets now: FALLBACK-1823 (P0) for config rollout and HOTPATCH-1824 (P2) as investigatory spike if fallback isn't sufficient.

sophia: Also proposing we add a targeted eval in Redwood Optimize that runs the customer prompt set nightly to catch prefix-streaming regressions automatically. If we have a baseline + alert, we can act earlier.

maya: Yes — link the eval to the regression alert and to the rollout runbook. @sam can you communicate the fallback plan + expected timelines to customer A after your sync?

sam: On it — I'll send a short note with the canary window + expected 24h monitor, and promise an update within 48h. :thumbsup:

liam: One more ops note — toggling fallback requires a config flip in the routing service. I'll include the exact snippet in the ticket:```yaml
routing:
  fallback_variant: model-v1.9
  canary_percentage: 10
```

maya: Perfect. If canary looks good we'll ramp to 100% for affected tenants by morning. Thanks everyone — I'll post the final decisions in the roadmap doc.

oliver: :thumbsup:
